summary: User wants to build a different/new website from scratch.

existing_features.title: Replace the existing CRACKIUM SSC coaching website with a completely new website. The new site must have a distinct concept, design language, color palette, and layout — nothing should visually resemble or reuse the current orange/glassmorphism dark-themed SSC academy site.

Apply a bold, creative visual theme to the new website — choose a distinct style (e.g., clean minimal, editorial, vibrant gradient, brutalist, nature-inspired, etc.) with a unique color palette, typography pairing, and layout that is consistently applied across all sections.

new_feature_requests.summary: The backend Motoko actor should remain as a minimal empty actor. No backend functionality is required for this new website.
